Bundle packages-v3/plugin/src/types.ts:585

A Bundle (a collection of assets)

Bundles can only be accessed during the plugin call they were passed to.

interface Bundle {
  readonly type: string;

The type of the bundle.

  readonly target: Target;

The bundle's target.

  readonly isEntry: boolean;

Whether the bundle is an entry.

  readonly needsStableName: boolean;

Indicates that the bundle's file name should be stable over time, even when the content of the bundle changes. This is useful for entries that a user would manually enter the URL for, as well as for things like service workers or RSS feeds, where the URL must remain consistent over time.

  readonly bundleBehavior: BundleBehavior | undefined;

Controls the behavior of the bundle.

  • inline: Inline bundles are not written to a separate file, but embedded into the parent bundle.
  • isolated: The bundle will be isolated from its parents. Shared assets will be duplicated.
  readonly hashReference: string;

A placeholder for the bundle's content hash. A namer must include it exactly once in the name of a bundle that may be content hashed. It is replaced with a content hash of the bundle after packaging and optimizing.

  readonly filePath: FilePath | null;

The absolute path the bundle is written to, once it is known. null for inline bundles, before the bundle is named, and while a content hashed name is unknown.

  readonly name: string | null;

The bundle's name: its file path relative to its target's distDir. null until it can be read, i.e. before the bundle is named, or while a content hashed name is unknown.

  getEntryAssets(): Array<Asset>;

Returns the assets that are executed immediately when the bundle is loaded. Some bundles may not have any entry assets, for example, shared bundles.

  getMainEntry(): Asset | undefined;

Returns the main entry of the bundle, which will provide the bundle's exports. Some bundles do not have a main entry, for example, shared bundles.

  hasAsset(asset: Asset): boolean;

Returns whether the bundle includes the given asset.

}
